#rom debug
#save after-first-dungeon
# DX: a KO gives one "The team gained N Exp. Points!" line, no per-member lines; level-ups keep theirs.
# Generated by tools/dxtest/gen_ai_exp_tests.py.
mash START sMainMenu 4 != 0 3000
wait 60
press UP
press A
wait 30
press A
wait 30
press UP
press UP
wait 10
expect *sDxWarp+0xB0 4 == 2
press A
wait 40
expect *sDxWarp+0xB0 4 == 1
press A
mash A gDungeon 4 != 0 1800
wait 600
expect *gDungeon+@gDxOffDungeonLocation 1 == 2
expect *gDungeon+@gDxOffDungeonFloor 1 == 1
write gDxTestCount+0 2 0
write gDxTestCount+2 2 0
write gDxTestCount+4 2 0
write gDxTestCount+6 2 0
write gDxTestCount+8 2 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!2 2 154
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!4 1 20
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2 999
read leader_level ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoLevel 1
write gDxTestStageTypes 1 255
write gDxTestStageHP 2 1
write gDxTestStageFoe 1 1
write gDxTestStageFoe+1 1 0
write gDxTestStageMate 1 0
write gDxTestStageMate+1 1 0
write gDxTestStage 1 1
waitfor gDxTestStage 1 == 0 900
wait 10
shot 1_staged
press A
waitfor gDxTestCount 2 >= 1 600
wait 40
shot 2_team_exp
wait 120
shot 3_level_up
wait 400
expect gDxTestCount 2 == 1
expect gDxTestCount+2 2 == 0
read leader_level_after ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoLevel 1
cmpreads leader_level_after > leader_level
